fields.about: Buccaneer Banner Brass is the alumni/community brass ensemble of the Reading Buccaneers Drum and Bugle Corps, based in Reading, Pennsylvania. The ensemble performs in exhibition at events such as the Buccaneer Classic.
The ConneXion (Connexion Performing Arts) is an all-age drum and bugle corps based in the Racine/Milwaukee, Wisconsin area, competing in the DCI SoundSport division as Wisconsin's only all-age corps.

RCR Street Club is a performing ensemble of River City Rhythm in Monticello, Minnesota. Debuting in 2025 as a reinvention of the organization's parade drumline, it offers a low-cost opportunity to perform in parades across the Midwest.

The Marching Elite Foundation is a Baltimore, Maryland nonprofit music and arts organization founded in 2006, serving East Baltimore youth ages 4-21 through drumline, dance, color guard, and marching band. It competes in the DCI SoundSport division.
